Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents:
Try something different:

Jet lag is no fun. The body can sometimes take a few days to adjust to being in a new time zone, and those days can be challenging. To address this very issue, Oura has introduced a Jet Lag Plan that aims to help users manage jet lag, if not fix it completely.

Add MakeUseOf on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

The update was announced on November 17 and will be available for Oura Ring Gen3 or newer versions. Of course, this feature will only be available to those who have an Oura membership.

Oura Ring 5 finally makes smart rings worth wearing — if you trust the company with your health data

This makes it the smallest smart ring in the world, with big implications for your health.

By  Sara Heritage
May 28, 2026

How it works

The core principle

The Jet Lag Plan is based around the circadian principle, or circadian rhythm, and your chronotype. The former is the body’s internal clock that is based on your home time zone. The latter is a natural biological preference for sleep, waking up, and alertness. The circadian rhythm is disrupted when you travel to different time zones, as the body still thinks it needs to sleep during the daytime in your current location, since it’s late at night in your home time zone.

Oura analyses your sleep history and chronotype to identify your circadian low point, which is when your body temperature is at its lowest. It then factors in how many time zones you’re crossing and schedules guidance for when you should get some light or drink coffee. Oura says getting light at the right time is key to resetting your circadian rhythm, and the plan will therefore suggest daily windows for seeking and avoiding bright light. This changes dynamically as your internal clock adjusts to the new time zone.

You don’t have to do much to set up your Jet Lag Plan. Simply input your flight details and purpose of your trip. Follow the timed daily actions recommended by the app. After the trip, you can check your personalized post-trip report. You can also track your Readiness as you progress through the plan.

The feature should show up in the app, but you can set up your Jet Lag Plan through an advisor as well.

Of course, there's no guarantee that the Jet Lag Plan will completely get rid of your jet lag, but it can help you manage it.

The Oura Ring 4 is a smart ring that tracks over 50 health metrics, including sleep, activity, stress, heart health and women's health. It uses Smart Sensing for continuous day and night data, with up to 8 days of battery life and no screen or vibrations. This listing is the Gold finish in size 8, and Oura recommends using its Sizing Kit before buying.
